## Full text

### `slidesend-name-accent`

Never accent, capitalise or hyphenate the two s of slidesend together, and never split the name: two highlighted s read as 'SS', which carries Nazi history in Germany (Carsten, 2026-10-06). The name is deliberately open to two readings, slide·send and slides·end, so nothing in the mark, copy, code or file names splits it. Since the logo kit 'the wave' (2026-11-03) neither s carries any accent: the wordmark's only coloured element is the dot of the i, a small slide in spotlight #F04E23. Same caution for any abbreviation: never 'ss' as a prefix (CSS variables use --slidesend-*, files slidesend-*).

---

### `logo-font-vectorization`

Logos are vectorized from Merriweather Black (wght 900) at the DEFAULT/text optical size — never the variable font's opsz max (144 = display), which looks 'not Merriweather'. The exact cut is Merriweather 2.002 (upem 1000), shipped by @fontsource/merriweather up to 5.2.x and vendored at scripts/fonts/merriweather-latin-900-normal.woff. Do NOT swap in @fontsource 5.3.0+: it ships Merriweather 2.100 (upem 2000) with different sidebearings, so letter spacing no longer matches the nxsflow wordmark. scripts/build-wordmarks generates the *-wordmark-* SVGs of nxsflow, nexflow.it and manufakt.io: plain advances, no kerning, 25/106 px per unit, 5px round-joined stroke in the ink colour, 26px padding, exactly ONE letter (the f) in the product accent; --check reports drift. It reproduces the original nxsflow wordmark to 0.01px. slidesend is the exception (2026-11-03): scripts/build-slidesend constructs its own monoline wordmark, its symbol 'the wave', one-colour versions (mono/), app icon (app-icon/), adaptive favicon and link preview; it only borrows build-wordmarks' Font class to set the preview's line in Merriweather. Favicon = monogram (nxsflow: n+f unmerged, logos/nexflow-parent/). scripts/render-logos renders logos/<family>/svg into png/ and favicon/, logos/<family>/social/*.svg at native size, app-icon/*.svg and mono/*.svg to PNGs, and for a family with an adaptive favicon/<prefix>-favicon.svg an opaque <prefix>-apple-touch-180.png — from app-icon/<prefix>-app-icon.svg when present, else on white (iOS fills transparency with black). The in-context mockups in logos/slidesend/in-context/ are rendered PNGs from the local logo-design skill, not regenerated by a repo script.

---

### `brand-skill-duplicate`

BRAND.md and plugin/skills/nxsflow-brand/SKILL.md are hand-maintained duplicates — there is NO generator for them (scripts/ holds render-logos, build-wordmarks and build-slidesend, all for logo assets only). Any change to the '## Messaging' section must be applied to both and verified byte-identical, e.g.: awk '/^## Messaging$/,/^## Colors$/' <file> on each, then diff. The same check is worth running for '## Logo System' (up to '## Design Language'). The plugin copy is the one actually read, because it loads into every assistant session. Content changes also bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (minor for refinements, major for breaking) — that is the repo convention.

---

### `brand-repo-public-rules`

nxsflow/brand is a PUBLIC repo. Two standing rules: (1) Language rule from the GTM spec — no competitor name, no 'alternative to', no comparison to another vendor's product anywhere: not in BRAND.md, not in a copy deck, not in a commit message or PR. Write what holds, never why it changed. (2) The nexus-flow board (.nxs symlink) and .nxf/ must stay out of git; both are in .gitignore since 2026-08-08 — do not remove those entries.

---

### `logo-monogram-or-wordmark`

A surface shows a product's monogram OR its wordmark, never both: no combined lockup, and never the monogram beside the product name set as text. slidesend has a symbol in the monogram's place, 'the wave' (a 16:9 slide split by a stepped wave: desk half in ink #17151F / paper #F7F5F2 on dark, stage half in spotlight #F04E23), under the same either/or rule; its link preview shows the wordmark only. The mark's colours are binding for the product's wordmark: same ink (#1C1C1C / #FAF9F7 for the Merriweather family) and the accent letter in exactly the monogram's accent — nexflow.it f #B9FF66 on light AND dark (not #84CC16), manufakt.io f #DC2626. slidesend's constructed wordmark is ink #17151F (paper #F7F5F2 on dark) with only the i-dot in spotlight #F04E23. Owner decisions 2026-09-23 (rnxt), 2026-10-05 (q4mj), 2026-11-03 (slidesend logo kit 'the wave', replacing violet and the stage-frame icon).
